class.name: YAMLStyle
class.brief_description: Configures formatting behavior for YAML serialization.
class.description:
[YAMLStyle] defines how Godot objects are serialized to YAML format. The class allows precise control over serialization styles, enabling better compatibility with existing YAML parsers and improving human readability of exported YAML content.
You can customize various styling aspects: - Container styles (array or dictionary)[br]- String styles (plain, quoted, block)[br]- Numeric formats (decimal, hex, octal, binary, scientific)[br]- Flow styles (block vs inline)
The class supports hierarchical style organization through a parent-child relationship, allowing you to define specific styles per key. This provides fine-grained control over document layout, which is particularly useful when: - Preserving human readability[br]- Matching existing YAML conventions[br]- Customizing the visual appearance of exported content[br]- Ensuring compatibility with external YAML parsers
[b]Basic styling example:[/b] [codeblock] # Create a new style configuration var style = YAML.create_style()
# Set global string style to double-quoted style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE)
# Set integers to display in hexadecimal format style.set_integer_format(YAMLStyle.INT_HEX)
# Define specific style for player inventory items to use flow style var inventory_style = style.create_child("player").create_child("inventory") inventory_style.set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_SINGLE)
# Create some data to format var player_data = { "name": "Hero", "level": 42, "player": { "inventory": ["Sword", "Shield", "Potion"] } }
# Apply the style when stringifying var result = YAML.stringify(player_data, style) print(result.get_data())
# Output will look like: # "name": "Hero" # "level": 0x2A # "player": # "inventory": ["Sword", "Shield", "Potion"] [/codeblock]
[b]Style hierarchy example:[/b] [codeblock] var style = YAML.create_style()
# Set global options style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_PLAIN)
# Configure multiline strings (like descriptions) to use literal block style style.get_at_path("items/*/description", true).set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_LITERAL)
# Configure nested maps to use inline flow style style.get_at_path("items/*/properties", true).set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_SINGLE)
# Example data structure with items that have descriptions and properties var data = { "items": [ { "name": "Magic Sword", "description": "A powerful sword\nwith magical properties.", "properties": { "damage": 50, "weight": 3, "magic": true } }, { "name": "Health Potion", "description": "Restores health\nwhen consumed.", "properties": { "heal": 25, "weight": 1 } } ] }
var result = YAML.stringify(data, style) print(result.get_data())
# Output will format the descriptions as literal blocks and properties as inline maps [/codeblock]

method.name: apply_scalar_styles_to_children
method.description:
Applies all scalar styles [enum StringStyle], [enum IntegerFormat], and [enum FloatFormat] and to all child styles.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var style = YAML.create_style()
# Set global scalar formats style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE) style.set_integer_format(YAMLStyle.INT_HEX) style.set_float_format(YAMLStyle.FLOAT_SCIENTIFIC)
# Create child styles for specific elements var player_style = style.create_child("player") var weapons_style = style.create_child("weapons") var armor_style = style.create_child("armor")
# Apply the parent's scalar formats to all children at once style.apply_scalar_styles_to_children()
# Now all children inherit the parent's scalar formats # (STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE, INT_HEX, FLOAT_SCIENTIFIC) [/codeblock]

method.name: clear_child
method.description:
Removes the child style associated with the specified [param key]. Returns this style instance for method chaining.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var style = YAML.create_style()
# Create child styles for various sections style.create_child("player") style.create_child("inventory") style.create_child("quests")
# Later, if we decide we don't need custom styling for inventory style.clear_child("inventory")
# Method chaining example style.clear_child("player").clear_child("quests") [/codeblock]

method.name: clear_children
method.description:
Removes all child styles from this style instance. Returns this style instance for method chaining.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var style = YAML.create_style()
# Create several child styles style.create_child("header") style.create_child("body") style.create_child("footer")
# Then remove all of them at once style.clear_children()
# Now we can start fresh with new child styles style.create_child("new_section") [/codeblock]

method.name: clone
method.description:
Creates a deep copy of this style object. Returns a new YAMLStyle instance with identical settings and child styles, but no shared references with the original.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] # Create and configure a base style var base_style = YAML.create_style() base_style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE) base_style.set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_NONE)
# Create a variant style based on the base style var variant_style = base_style.clone()
# Modify the variant without affecting the original variant_style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_SINGLE) variant_style.set_integer_format(YAMLStyle.INT_HEX)
# Use both styles for different documents var config_result = YAML.stringify(config_data, base_style) var export_result = YAML.stringify(export_data, variant_style) [/codeblock]

method.name: container_form_from_string
container_form_string
method.description:
Converts a [enum ContainerForm] value to its string identifier. Returns the string name representing the specified container [param form].
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] # Convert enum values to their string representations var form_name = YAMLStyle.container_form_string(YAMLStyle.FORM_ARRAY) print(form_name) # Output: "FORM_ARRAY"
# Useful for debugging or displaying style information func print_style_info(style): var form = style.get_container_form() print("Container form: ", YAMLStyle.container_form_string(form)) [/codeblock]

method.name: create_child
method.description:
Creates a new child style for the specified [param key] if it doesn't exist, or returns the existing one. This method combines checking for a child's existence and creating it in a single call.
If [param inherit_styles] is [code]true[/code], all scalar styles are copied from parent to child. See [method propagate_scalar_styles].
Returns the new or existing child style, allowing for method chaining.
[b]Example of style hierarchy:[/b] [codeblock] var style = YAML.create_style()
# Create a hierarchical structure of styles var maps_style = style.create_child("maps") var items_style = maps_style.create_child("items") var first_item_style = items_style.create_child("0")
# Configure styles at different levels style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE) # Global setting maps_style.set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_NONE) # Maps use block style items_style.set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_SINGLE) # Items use flow style first_item_style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_LITERAL) # First item uses literal strings
# This creates a structure that formats specific parts of the YAML differently [/codeblock]
[b]Example of inheritance behavior:[/b] [codeblock] var style = YAML.create_style() style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE) style.set_integer_format(YAMLStyle.INT_HEX)
# Create child with inheritance (default behavior) var child1 = style.create_child("child1") print(child1.get_string_style()) # Output: STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE (inherited)
# Create child without inheritance var child2 = style.create_child("child2", false) print(child2.get_string_style()) # Output: STRING_ANY (default value, not inherited) [/codeblock]

method.name: float_format_from_string
float_format_string
method.description:
Converts a [enum FloatFormat] value to its string identifier. Returns the string name representing the specified floating-point [param format].
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] # Get string representations of float formats var decimal_name = YAMLStyle.float_format_string(YAMLStyle.FLOAT_DECIMAL) var scientific_name = YAMLStyle.float_format_string(YAMLStyle.FLOAT_SCIENTIFIC)
print(decimal_name) # Output: "FLOAT_DECIMAL" print(scientific_name) # Output: "FLOAT_SCIENTIFIC"
# Create a settings UI for float formats func populate_format_dropdown(): var dropdown = $FormatDropdown dropdown.add_item("Default", YAMLStyle.FLOAT_ANY) dropdown.add_item("Decimal", YAMLStyle.FLOAT_DECIMAL) dropdown.add_item("Scientific", YAMLStyle.FLOAT_SCIENTIFIC)
# Set current selection based on style var current_format = current_style.get_float_format() var format_text = YAMLStyle.float_format_string(current_format) print("Current format: ", format_text) [/codeblock]

method.name: flow_style_from_string
flow_style_string
method.description:
Converts a [enum FlowStyle] value to its string identifier. Returns the string name representing the specified flow [param style].
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] # Get names for all flow style options var styles = [ YAMLStyle.FLOW_ANY, YAMLStyle.FLOW_NONE, YAMLStyle.FLOW_SINGLE ]
for s in styles: var name = YAMLStyle.flow_style_string(s) print("Style ", s, ": ", name)
# Save style configuration to a dictionary func save_style_config(style): var config = {} config.flow_style = YAMLStyle.flow_style_string(style.get_flow_style()) config.string_style = YAMLStyle.string_style_string(style.get_string_style()) return config [/codeblock]

method.name: from_dictionary
get_at_path
method.description:
Gets a child style at the specified [param path], with an option to create missing nodes along the way. The path uses [code]/[/code] as a separator, and array indices can be specified numerically.
If [param create_if_missing] is [code]true[/code], any missing children in the path will be created. If [code]false[/code] and a child in the path doesn't exist, returns [code]null[/code].
[b]Example of deep path access:[/b] [codeblock] var style = YAML.create_style()
# Access or create deep nested styles in a single call var properties_style = style.get_at_path("maps/items/0/properties", true) properties_style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE) properties_style.set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_SINGLE)
# Try to access a path that may not exist var existing_style = style.get_at_path("maps/items/1/properties", false) if existing_style != null: print("Found existing style!") else: print("Path doesn't exist yet") [/codeblock]
[b]Example for array element styling:[/b] [codeblock] var style = YAML.create_style()
# Style for the entire array var array_style = style.get_at_path("items", true) array_style.set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_NONE) # Block style for the array
# Style for specific array elements (by index) style.get_at_path("items/0", true).set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE) style.get_at_path("items/1", true).set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_SINGLE) style.get_at_path("items/2", true).set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_LITERAL)
# Apply to data with array elements var data = { "items": [ "First item with double quotes", "Second item with single quotes", "Third item as\na literal block" ] }
var result = YAML.stringify(data, style) print(result.get_data()) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_child
get_debug_string
has_child
method.description:
Returns [code]true[/code] if a child style has been defined for the specified [param key], [code]false[/code] otherwise. Use this method to check for the existence of a child style before accessing it.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var style = YAML.create_style()
# Create some child styles style.create_child("header") style.create_child("body")
# Check existence before using if style.has_child("header"): var header_style = style.get_child("header") header_style.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE)
# Conditional creation if !style.has_child("footer"): style.create_child("footer").set_flow_style(YAMLStyle.FLOW_SINGLE)
# Using has_child with get_child is safer than just using get_child # since get_child returns null if the child doesn't exist [/codeblock]

method.name: hash
method.description:
Calculates a hash value for the style instance, including all its properties and child styles. This is useful for comparing styles or using them as dictionary keys.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] # Create two styles to compare var style1 = YAML.create_style() style1.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE)
var style2 = YAML.create_style() style2.set_string_style(YAMLStyle.STRING_QUOTE_DOUBLE)
# Check if the styles are equivalent using their hash values if style1.hash() == style2.hash(): print("Styles are equivalent") else: print("Styles are different")
# Create a slight variation var style3 = style1.clone() style3.create_child("header")
print("style1 hash: ", style1.hash()) print("style3 hash: ", style3.hash()) print("Equivalent: ", style1.hash() == style3.hash()) # Will be false [/codeblock]
